title: Residential Tower, 2B + G + 35 (GCC)
scope: Reinforced-concrete tower with a jump-formed core, 6-day slab cycle, unitised facade trailing the frame and MEP / finishes chasing floor by floor.
assume: Floor plate 30 m × 26 m, 3.3 m floor-to-floor; 9 m × 9 m core with 4 lift shafts; 20 perimeter columns.
Core jump form climbs 2 levels ahead of the slab (logic link core L → slab L-2). Facade starts 6 floors behind the frame.
